title: Priority
lede: The live evaluation order, one level deep. The base runs top to bottom and stacks. A group decides among its own campaigns with its mode, then the base carries on.
cascade: Groups always cascade: every discount is taken on what is left after the discounts above it.
publishes: HQ has no order of its own to save: the order is saved with a campaign draft and goes to tills when that draft is activated, so a till never mixes two orders.

legend.label: What a group's mode and scope mean
legend.stackable: every campaign that triggers applies, in order.
legend.first: the first campaign that actually yields wins; one stopped by a budget or a refused coupon passes the turn.
legend.highest: each campaign runs on the same basket and the most discount money wins; points do not count.
legend.item: the group decides per unit, so each unit has one winner; only item discounts may sit in it.
